state_path.description: Base state path for Neutron, used to construct the metadata proxy socket path.

metadata_proxy_user.description: User (uid or name) running metadata proxy after its initialization (if empty: agent effective user).

metadata_proxy_group.description: Group (gid or name) running metadata proxy after its initialization (if empty: agent effective group).

metadata_proxy_socket_mode.description: Metadata Proxy UNIX domain socket mode.

metadata_workers.description: Number of separate worker processes for metadata server.

metadata_backlog.description: Number of backlog requests to configure the metadata server socket with.

auth_ca_cert.description: Certificate Authority public key (CA cert) file for ssl.

nova_metadata_host.description: IP address or DNS name of Nova metadata server.

nova_metadata_port.description: TCP Port used by Nova metadata server.

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret for signing Instance-ID header for Nova metadata proxying.

nova_metadata_protocol.description: Protocol to access Nova metadata, http or https.

nova_metadata_insecure.description: Allow to perform insecure SSL (https) requests to Nova metadata.

nova_client_cert.description: Client certificate for Nova metadata api server.

debug.description: If set to true, the logging level will be set to DEBUG instead of the default INFO level.

log_config_append.description: The name of a logging configuration file.

log_date_format.description: Defines the format string for %%(asctime)s in log records.

log_file.description: Name of log file to send logging output to.

log_dir.description: The base directory used for relative log_file paths.

watch_log_file.description: Uses logging handler designed to watch file system.

syslog_log_facility.description: Syslog facility to receive log lines.

log_color.description: Set the 'color' key according to log levels.

log_rotate_interval.description: The amount of time before the log files are rotated.

max_logfile_count.description: Maximum number of rotated log files.

max_logfile_size_mb.description: Log file maximum size in MB.

logging_context_format_string.description: Format string to use for log messages with context.

logging_default_format_string.description: Format string to use for log messages when context is undefined.

logging_debug_format_suffix.description: Additional data to append to log message when logging level for the message is DEBUG.

logging_exception_prefix.description: Prefix each line of exception output with this format.

logging_user_identity_format.description: Defines the format string for %(user_identity)s that is used in logging_context_format_string.

default_log_levels.description: List of package logging levels in logger=LEVEL pairs.

publish_errors.description: Enables or disables publication of error events.

instance_format.description: The format for an instance that is passed with the log message.

instance_uuid_format.description: The format for an instance UUID that is passed with the log message.

rate_limit_interval.description: Interval, number of seconds, of log rate limiting.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of logged messages per rate_limit_interval.

rate_limit_except_level.description: Log level name used by rate limiting.

fatal_deprecations.description: Enables or disables fatal status of deprecations.

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable rate limiting on the metadata API.

ip_versions.description: Comma separated list of the metadata address IP versions (4, 6) for which rate limiting will be enabled.

base_window_duration.description: Duration (seconds) of the base window on the metadata API.

base_query_rate_limit.description: Max number of queries to accept during the base window.

burst_window_duration.description: Duration (seconds) of the burst window on the metadata API.

burst_query_rate_limit.description: Max number of queries to accept during the burst window.

ovn_nb_connection.description: The connection string for the OVN_Northbound OVSDB.

ovn_nb_private_key.description: The PEM file with private key for SSL connection to OVN-NB-DB.

ovn_nb_certificate.description: The PEM file with certificate that certifies the private key specified in ovn_nb_private_key.

ovn_nb_ca_cert.description: The PEM file with CA certificate that OVN should use to verify certificates presented to it by SSL peers.

ovn_sb_connection.description: The connection string for the OVN_Southbound OVSDB.

ovn_sb_private_key.description: The PEM file with private key for SSL connection to OVN-SB-DB.

ovn_sb_certificate.description: The PEM file with certificate that certifies the private key specified in ovn_sb_private_key.

ovn_sb_ca_cert.description: The PEM file with CA certificate that OVN should use to verify certificates presented to it by SSL peers.

ovsdb_connection_timeout.description: Timeout, in seconds, for the OVSDB connection transaction.

ovsdb_retry_max_interval.description: Max interval, in seconds ,between each retry to get the OVN NB and SB IDLs.

ovsdb_probe_interval.description: The probe interval for the OVSDB session, in milliseconds.

neutron_sync_mode.description: The synchronization mode of OVN_Northbound OVSDB with Neutron DB.

ovn_l3_scheduler.description: The OVN L3 Scheduler type used to schedule router gateway ports on hypervisors/chassis.

vhost_sock_dir.description: The directory in which vhost virtio sockets are created by all the vswitch daemons.

dhcp_default_lease_time.description: Default lease time (in seconds) to use with OVN's native DHCP service.

ovsdb_log_level.description: The log level used for OVSDB.

dns_servers.description: Comma-separated list of the DNS servers which will be used as forwarders if a subnet's dns_nameservers field is empty.

dns_records_ovn_owned.description: Whether to consider DNS records local to OVN or not.

ovn_dhcp4_global_options.description: Dictionary of global DHCPv4 options which will be automatically set on each subnet upon creation.

ovn_dhcp6_global_options.description: Dictionary of global DHCPv6 options which will be automatically set on each subnet upon creation.

ovn_emit_need_to_frag.description: Configure OVN to emit 'need to frag' packets in case of MTU mismatches.

disable_ovn_dhcp_for_baremetal_ports.description: Disable OVN's built-in DHCP for baremetal ports.

localnet_learn_fdb.description: If enabled it will allow localnet ports to learn MAC addresses and store them in FDB SB table.

fdb_age_threshold.description: The number of seconds to keep FDB entries in the OVN DB.

mac_binding_age_threshold.description: The number of seconds to keep MAC_Binding entries in the OVN DB.

broadcast_arps_to_all_routers.description: If enabled (default) OVN will flood ARP requests to all attached ports on a network.

ovn_router_indirect_snat.description: Whether to configure SNAT for all nested subnets connected to the router through any other routers.

live_migration_activation_strategy.description: Activation strategy to use for live migration.

ovsdb_connection_timeout_ovs.description: Timeout in seconds for the OVSDB connection transaction.

ovsdb_connection.description: The connection string for the OVSDB backend.

ssl_key_file.description: The SSL private key file to use when interacting with OVSDB.

ssl_cert_file.description: The SSL certificate file to use when interacting with OVSDB.

ssl_ca_cert_file.description: The Certificate Authority (CA) certificate to use when interacting with OVSDB.
